notes.claim: A transformer's turns ratio is the same as its voltage ratio.

The Maritime and Coastguard Agency's General Engineering Science syllabus asks candidates to solve problems on ratio, proportion and percentage, and its Part II syllabus asks them to state Boyle's law.

sources.title: Transformer Basics and Transformer Principles, Electronics Tutorials
sources.quote: the turns ratio of any given transformer will be the same as its voltage ratio.

sources.title: General Engineering Science I Written Examination Syllabuses, MCA (GOV.UK)
sources.quote: Solve problems on ratio, proportion and percentage.

sources.title: General Engineering Science II Written Examination Syllabuses, MCA (GOV.UK)
sources.quote: State Charles’ Law and Boyle’s Law and derive the combination PV/T = C.
